nvidia-grace-cpu-superchip.name: NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip
nvidia-grace-cpu-superchip.description: No-compromise Arm data center CPU superchip for cloud, enterprise, HPC, data analytics, and memory-intensive compute workloads.

specs.CPU Cores: 144 Arm Neoverse V2 cores with 4x128b SVE2
specs.CPU Memory: 240 GB, 480 GB, or 960 GB LPDDR5X on-module memory with ECC
specs.PCIe: Up to 8x PCIe Gen5 x16 with bifurcation option
specs.Primary Workload: Cloud, enterprise, HPC, data analytics, memory-intensive CPU workloads

nvidia-gh200-grace-hopper-superchip.name: NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchip
nvidia-gh200-grace-hopper-superchip.description: Grace CPU plus H100 GPU superchip connected by NVLink-C2C coherent memory for large-scale AI, HPC, data analytics, and memory-intensive workloads.

specs.CPU Memory: Up to 480 GB LPDDR5X with ECC
specs.GPU Memory: Up to 96 GB HBM3 or 144 GB HBM3e
specs.GPU Memory Bandwidth: Up to 4 TB/s HBM3 or 4.9 TB/s HBM3e
specs.TDP: Programmable from 450 W to 1,000 W (CPU + GPU + memory)
specs.Primary Workload: AI, HPC, data analytics, memory-intensive workloads
specs.Source: NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchip Datasheet
